age.evidence: 52 adult male Sprague-Dawley rats (Envigo, Somerset, NJ) that weighed approximately 300 g at the time of surgery

sex.evidence: Studies were conducted in 52 adult male Sprague-Dawley rats

dosing.doses_raw: .0032-.1 mg/kg (acute dose-effect); .01 and .32 mg/kg (time-course); .01, .1, or .32 mg/kg/day (repeated)
dosing.evidence: Separate groups of rats were used for initial dose-effect studies with LSD (.0032-.1 mg/kg; N = 6)... Twenty-seven drug-naïve rats were divided into four groups for repeated treatment with saline or .01, .1, or .32 mg/kg/day LSD. All drugs were dissolved in sterile water.
mescaline (.32-10 mg/kg; N = 6)... Saline vehicle or a drug dose was administered intraperitoneally. All drugs were dissolved in sterile water.
psilocybin (.032-1.0 mg/kg; N = 6)... administered intraperitoneally. All drugs were dissolved in sterile water.

group_housing.evidence: Rats were singly housed, had ad libitum access to food and water in the home cage

day_night_flipped.evidence: kept under a 12-hr light-dark cycle (lights on 6 a.m. -6 p.m.)

assays.assay_description: Frequency-rate ICSS in operant chambers (29.2 × 30.5 × 24.1 cm) with stimulating electrode targeting medial forebrain bundle; FR1 lever-press for brain stimulation across 10 frequencies (1.75-2.2 log Hz); 30-min sessions of three 10-min components. Acute dose-effect, time-course, and 9-day repeated LSD protocols with cumulative dosing of LSD, methamphetamine, and U69,593.

application_type.evidence: Saline vehicle or a drug dose was administered intraperitoneally at the start of the time-out period.

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were allowed at least 5 recovery days before initiation of ICSS training... ICSS training was considered complete when frequency-rate curves were not statistically different over three consecutive days of training

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were trained to lever-press... in operant conditioning chambers; freely moving with intracranial electrode connected via swivel-commutator

food_restriction.evidence: Rats were singly housed, had ad libitum access to food and water in the home cage

water_restriction.evidence: ad libitum access to food and water in the home cage

time_to_assay.evidence: two 'test' components [after 15-min time-out following injection]; time-course test sessions had test components beginning after 10, 30, 100, 180, and 300 min; repeated dosing had 10-min time-out then test

sample_size.evidence: Studies were conducted in 52 adult male Sprague-Dawley rats... N = 6 per dose-effect group; N = 7 per group except .32 mg/kg/day, where N = 6

outcomes.summary: Acute LSD, mescaline, and psilocybin produced weak, inconsistent ICSS facilitation at low doses and reliable dose- and time-dependent ICSS depression at higher doses. Repeated daily LSD (7 days) did not alter baseline ICSS, did not produce tolerance to LSD-induced depression, and did not alter methamphetamine-induced ICSS facilitation, but .1 and .32 mg/kg/day LSD attenuated U69,593-induced ICSS depression.
outcomes.statistics: LSD: F(4,20)=35.81, p<.001; Frequency×Dose F(36,180)=2.817, p<.001. Mescaline: F(4,20)=4.578, p=.009. Psilocybin: F(4,20)=15.51, p<.001. Repeated LSD × U69,593: Frequency × Treatment Group interaction F(27,207)=1.966, p=.0045.
outcomes.evidence: LSD, mescaline, and psilocybin produce weak and inconsistent evidence of ICSS facilitation at lower doses and more consistent ICSS depression at higher doses... .1 and .32 mg/kg/day LSD attenuated ICSS depression by U69,593

B1_num_measures.evidence: primary dependent variable... was the reinforcement rate in stimulations per trial... we determined the total number of stimulations per component

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Normalized data across each pair of baseline components and each pair of test components were then averaged; time-course tests are separate sessions (between-session comparisons), not within-session temporal dynamics.

B4_ethological.evidence: Lever-pressing for brain stimulation is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Single rat tested alone in operant chamber.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Rats were trained to lever-press under a fixed-ratio 1 (FR 1) schedule for brain stimulation; operant learned response.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: lever-press responses were recorded with a computer and interface operated by MED-PC IV Computer software

B8_multivariate.evidence: Frequency-rate curves were analyzed using two-way repeated measures analysis of variance; no PCA/clustering.

E1_environment_type.evidence: operant conditioning chambers (29.2 cm × 30.5 cm × 24.1 cm) housed in sound-attenuating boxes

E2_shelter.evidence: No shelter described in operant chamber.

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard operant chamber, no bedding described.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in operant chamber.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Chamber equipped with response lever, stimulus lights, and house light only.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single operant chamber with one lever.

E7_social_context.evidence: Rat tested individually in operant chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in testing chamber; reinforcer was brain stimulation.

D1_continuity.evidence: Test sessions were conducted once per week (dose-effect); weekly for time-course; daily sessions across a 9-day protocol for repeated LSD studies.

D2_session_duration.evidence: 30-min behavioral sessions consisting of three 10-min components; cumulative-dosing sessions extended across multiple 30-min intervals.

D3_recording_days.evidence: On Days 1-6, daily test sessions... On Day 7... On Days 8 and 9, additional cumulative-dosing test sessions

D4_baseline.evidence: data from the last 3 days of training established the predrug baseline parameters of ICSS; each session began with three baseline components.

D5_followup.evidence: Test components ran 10-300 min post-injection; no recordings ≥24 h after last dose in acute studies. Repeated dosing tests are during ongoing daily treatment.

D6_circadian.evidence: No single recording session spanned ≥6 hours; longest time-course was 300 min.

judge_notes: All candidates agreed on a single ICSS assay; consolidated into one entry covering acute dose-effect, time-course, and repeated LSD cumulative-dosing studies per rubric's 'same paradigm under different conditions = 1 assay' rule.
Drug vehicle set to 'water' (paper: 'All drugs were dissolved in sterile water'), overriding gptoss's 'saline'.
B2 scored 0: time-course tests are separate sessions on different days (between-session), not within-session temporal dynamics; glm/gptoss incorrectly scored 1.
setup_habituation scored 'yes' based on extensive ICSS training to stable baseline prior to drug testing.

food/water_restriction set to 'no' since rats had ad libitum access and food/water were not in the apparatus but ICSS reinforcer (brain stimulation) was continuously available — per rubric, 'no' applies when accessible throughout; here the standard 'during' interpretation was overridden because the operant task itself delivers reinforcement, but conservatively follows the ad libitum housing statement. (qwen used 'during' interpretation; glm used 'no'.)
time_to_assay set to 'multiple' since the same assay was tested at 10, 30, 100, 180, 300 min post-dose plus repeated/cumulative dosing protocols.
D5 followup scored 0: no recordings reported ≥24 h after last drug administration in acute studies; repeated dosing tests occurred during ongoing daily treatment.
